outcome_definition: Outcome = mean measured homozygote dTm (C) within one bimorphism, pooled over the 38 Exp. 1 markers (dual-labelled probe Tm) and 18 Exp. 3 markers (NNNs-HRM), all soybean Aokimame x Fukuyutaka and Oryza Fukuyutaka x Toyoshirome. 'measured'. G/T has the 2nd-lowest mean dTm but is NOT 2nd on mean |ddG3bp| (A/G is), so the free-energy index does not order the substitution classes observed.
